title: feat: add Lightning Image Turbo (InferencePort) image model
author: sharktide
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `inferenceport-ai/lightning-image-turbo` as an official paid-only image model at 0.02 Pollen per image.
- Uses InferencePort's documented `/v1/images/generations` route for text generation and up to two reference images for visual guidance. Precise scene-preserving editing is not claimed.
- Bills from the provider-reported `image_count`, supports URL and base64 responses, and rejects unsupported sizes, transparency, or excess references with 4xx errors.
- Sets a 15 RPM per-user limit and adds the InferencePort catalog logo. No equivalent fallback route was found.

Validation:

- 67 focused Workers tests and Gen TypeScript check pass.
- Authenticated local E2E covered native and OpenAI-compatible routes, one and two references, paid-only rejection, invalid inputs, disconnect/rejoin, and completed-cache retrieval.
- Six gateway generations matched six staging billing events and a 0.12 Pollen wallet debit; the provider ledger matched the three isolated provider checks.

gist.headline: Lightning in a flower pot
gist.blurb: Lightning Image Turbo joins the image models. Give it a prompt and up to two reference images; it will make something new, rather than promise pixel-perfect edits.
gist.summary: Added InferencePort's `inferenceport-ai/lightning-image-turbo` as a paid-only image model at 0.02 Pollen per image, with text-to-image generation and guidance from up to two reference images.
gist.impact: Users can generate images through native or OpenAI-compatible routes at a 15 RPM per-user limit, with URL or base64 responses and clear 4xx errors for unsupported inputs.
gist.visual_concept: Show Polli arranging one or two reference pictures beside a glowing image frame, with a small lightning bolt representing Lightning Image Turbo. An InferencePort catalog badge can identify the provider; code-plants and flowers keep the scene grounded in the pollinations garden.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden studio, Polli places two little reference pictures beside a glowing image frame as a gentle lightning-bolt sprite lights it up; lime green (#ecf874) code-plants and pastel flowers surround a small InferencePort badge.
